description: Build the onboarding flow (3-step wizard), the compliance feed dashboard with filtering/search, the detail view for regulations, the action items tracking system, and the email alert preferences settings page.
steps: Create app/onboarding/page.tsx - multi-step onboarding wizard (client component) with 3 steps: Step 1 (Business Type: SaaS, E-commerce, Mobile App, Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Marketplace, Other - selectable cards), Step 2 (Tech Stack: iOS/App Store, Android/Play Store, Web App, AWS, GCP, Azure, Stripe/Payments, etc. - multi-select checkboxes/chips), Step 3 (Regions: EU/GDPR, US-California/CCPA, US-Federal, UK, Canada, Australia, Brazil, India - multi-select with flag icons). Include a progress bar, back/next navigation, and submit that calls POST /api/onboarding
Create app/api/onboarding/route.ts - POST endpoint that updates the current user's businessType, techStack, and regions fields in the database

Create components/dashboard/RegulationCard.tsx - card component showing: regulation name, date (relative like '2 days ago'), severity badge (critical=red, warning=amber, info=blue), affected area tag, 2-line summary truncated. Clickable to go to detail view

Create components/dashboard/FilterBar.tsx - filter bar with: severity multi-select (Critical, Warning, Info), category dropdown (Privacy, App Store, Security, Accessibility, Healthcare), date range selector, and a search input field. All filters update URL query params
Create components/dashboard/ComplianceStats.tsx - stats bar showing: total regulations tracked, action items pending, compliance percentage (completed/total action items), critical alerts count

Create app/dashboard/page.tsx - protected page (redirect to signin if not authenticated) showing ComplianceStats at top, FilterBar below, then a list of RegulationCards. Fetches data from /api/regulations with filter params. Show empty state if user hasn't completed onboarding (link to /onboarding)

Create app/dashboard/layout.tsx - dashboard layout with sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Action Items, Settings links), top bar with user avatar/name and sign out button, main content area. Mobile responsive with collapsible sidebar

Create app/dashboard/regulations/[id]/page.tsx - detail page for a regulation showing: full title, published date, severity badge, affected regions, full description, 'What Changed' section, 'Action Items' section listing developer tasks with checkboxes to mark status, deadline if applicable. Back button to dashboard

Create app/api/regulations/route.ts - GET endpoint that returns regulations filtered by the current user's profile (matching techStack and regions), supports query params for severity, category, search, dateFrom, dateTo
Create app/api/regulations/[id]/route.ts - GET endpoint returning single regulation with its action items and the current user's completion status for each

Create app/dashboard/actions/page.tsx - action items page showing all user's action items grouped by status (Todo, In Progress, Completed). Each item shows title, associated regulation, priority, and status toggle buttons. Shows overall compliance progress bar at top
Create app/api/actions/route.ts - GET endpoint returning all action items for the current user with their statuses. POST endpoint to update an action item's status (TODO, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED)
Create app/api/actions/[id]/route.ts - PATCH endpoint to update a specific action item's status for the current user

Create app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx - settings page with: alert frequency radio buttons (Immediate, Daily digest, Weekly digest), severity level checkboxes (which levels trigger alerts), save button that calls PATCH /api/settings. Show success toast on save
Create app/api/settings/route.ts - GET endpoint returning current user settings, PATCH endpoint updating alertFrequency and severityLevels
Create middleware.ts in root - Next.js middleware that protects /dashboard/* routes, redirecting to /signin if no session. Also redirects authenticated users from /signin and /signup to /dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding flow works as 3-step wizard with progress bar
Dashboard shows regulation cards filtered by user profile
Filter bar allows filtering by severity, category, date, and search text
Regulation detail page shows full info with action items
Action items can be toggled between TODO/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED statuses
Compliance progress percentage is calculated from action item completion
Settings page allows configuring alert frequency and severity preferences
All dashboard routes are protected by middleware
All API routes validate authentication and return proper error responses
verification: npx tsc --noEmit passes without type errors
findings: All 19 files created successfully. Middleware protects dashboard/onboarding routes and redirects authenticated users from auth pages. Onboarding is a 3-step wizard. Dashboard layout has responsive sidebar. Regulations API filters by user's regions and supports search/severity/category/dateRange. Action items use upsert for UserActionItem. Both tsc --noEmit and npm run build pass cleanly.
